import sys
from itertools import repeat
from operator import itemgetter

def main():
    rows = sys.stdin.buffer.read().rstrip().split(b"\n")[1:]
    parts = list(map(bytes.split, rows, repeat(b",")))
    sums = {}
    get = sums.get
    for c, v in zip(map(itemgetter(1), parts), map(float, map(itemgetter(2), parts))):
        sums[c] = get(c, 0.0) + v
    out = [c.decode() + "," + "%.2f" % sums[c] for c in sorted(sums)]
    if out:
        sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
